cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  project(LMX_Bundles_Extra LANGUAGES C)
  set(LMX_BUNDLES_STANDALONE ON)
  if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MinSizeRel CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
  endif()
endif()
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
option(LMX_BUNDLES_EXTRA_BUILD_TESTS "Build offline bundle checks" ${LMX_BUNDLES_STANDALONE})
set(LMX_BUNDLES_VENDOR_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../vendor" CACHE PATH "Retained sources; no downloads")
include(prepare_bundles.cmake)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
function(lmx_bundle_target name)
  target_compile_features(${name} PUBLIC c_std_99)
  set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES C_EXTENSIONS NO POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
  if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
    target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE -pedantic-errors)
  endif()
  if(UNIX)
    target_compile_definitions(${name} PRIVATE _POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L _DEFAULT_SOURCE=1)
  endif()
endfunction()
add_library(lmx_bundles_extra INTERFACE)
add_library(LMX::bundles_extra ALIAS lmx_bundles_extra)
add_library(lmx_bundle_gb STATIC src/gb.c)
add_library(LMX::gb ALIAS lmx_bundle_gb)
target_include_directories(lmx_bundle_gb PUBLIC "${_gen}" "${LMX_BUNDLES_VENDOR_DIR}/gb")
target_link_libraries(lmx_bundle_gb PUBLIC Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
if(UNIX)
  target_link_libraries(lmx_bundle_gb PUBLIC m)
endif()
lmx_bundle_target(lmx_bundle_gb)
target_link_libraries(lmx_bundles_extra INTERFACE LMX::gb)
foreach(part c2 tiled aseprite png spritebatch sync net)
  add_library(lmx_cute_${part} STATIC src/cute_${part}.c)
  add_library(LMX::cute_${part} ALIAS lmx_cute_${part})
  target_include_directories(lmx_cute_${part} PUBLIC "${_gen}" "${LMX_BUNDLES_VENDOR_DIR}/cute_headers")
  lmx_bundle_target(lmx_cute_${part})
  if(UNIX)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_cute_${part} PUBLIC m)
  endif()
  target_link_libraries(lmx_bundles_extra INTERFACE LMX::cute_${part})
endforeach()
target_link_libraries(lmx_cute_sync PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
  target_compile_definitions(lmx_cute_sync PRIVATE _GNU_SOURCE=1)
endif()
if(WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(lmx_cute_net PUBLIC ws2_32 bcrypt)
endif()
# Reuse a separately reviewed SDL3, never download or embed a second copy.
if(NOT TARGET LMX::sdl3 AND NOT TARGET SDL3::SDL3-static)
  find_package(SDL3 CONFIG QUIET)
endif()
set(_sound_default OFF)
if(TARGET LMX::sdl3 OR TARGET SDL3::SDL3-static OR TARGET SDL3::SDL3)
  set(_sound_default ON)
endif()
option(LMX_BUNDLES_WITH_SOUND "Include cute_sound with existing SDL3" ${_sound_default})
if(LMX_BUNDLES_WITH_SOUND)
  add_library(lmx_cute_sound STATIC src/cute_sound.c)
  add_library(LMX::cute_sound ALIAS lmx_cute_sound)
  target_include_directories(lmx_cute_sound PUBLIC "${_gen}" "${LMX_BUNDLES_VENDOR_DIR}/cute_headers")
  lmx_bundle_target(lmx_cute_sound)
  if(TARGET LMX::sdl3)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_cute_sound PUBLIC LMX::sdl3)
  elseif(TARGET SDL3::SDL3-static)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_cute_sound PUBLIC SDL3::SDL3-static)
  elseif(TARGET SDL3::SDL3)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_cute_sound PUBLIC SDL3::SDL3)
  else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "cute_sound requires a separately supplied SDL3 target/package")
  endif()
  if(UNIX)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_cute_sound PUBLIC m)
  endif()
  target_link_libraries(lmx_bundles_extra INTERFACE LMX::cute_sound)
endif()
include(ea_sources.cmake)
set(_ea_wrappers)
foreach(source IN LISTS LMX_EA_SOURCES)
  string(REPLACE "/" "_" stem "${source}")
  set(input "${LMX_BUNDLES_VENDOR_DIR}/ea_libc/src/${source}")
  if(source STREQUAL "stdlib/calloc.c")
    set(input "${_gen}/ea_calloc_input.c")
  elseif(source STREQUAL "stdlib/strtoull.c")
    set(input "${_gen}/ea_strtoull_input.c")
  elseif(source STREQUAL "wchar/towccase.c")
    set(input "${_gen}/ea_towccase_input.c")
  elseif(source STREQUAL "wchar/wcwidth.c")
    set(input "${_gen}/ea_wcwidth_input.c")
  elseif(source STREQUAL "wchar/iswspace.c")
    set(input "${_gen}/ea_iswspace_input.c")
  endif()
  file(WRITE "${_gen}/ea_${stem}" "#include \"ea_host_headers.h\"\n#include \"ea_namespace.h\"\n#include \"${input}\"\n")
  list(APPEND _ea_wrappers "${_gen}/ea_${stem}")
endforeach()
add_library(lmx_ea_libc STATIC ${_ea_wrappers})
add_library(LMX::ea_libc ALIAS lmx_ea_libc)
target_include_directories(lmx_ea_libc PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/include" PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src" "${LMX_BUNDLES_VENDOR_DIR}/ea_libc/src/wchar")
lmx_bundle_target(lmx_ea_libc)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
  target_compile_options(lmx_ea_libc PRIVATE -fno-builtin -fno-strict-aliasing)
endif()
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
  target_compile_options(lmx_ea_libc PRIVATE -fno-tree-loop-distribute-patterns)
endif()
target_link_libraries(lmx_bundles_extra INTERFACE LMX::ea_libc)
if(LMX_BUNDLES_EXTRA_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  foreach(part gb c2 tiled aseprite png spritebatch sync net ea_libc sound)
    if(part STREQUAL "sound" AND NOT LMX_BUNDLES_WITH_SOUND)
      continue()
    endif()
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/tests/${part}.c")
      add_executable(lmx_bundles_check_${part} tests/${part}.c)
      lmx_bundle_target(lmx_bundles_check_${part})
      if(part STREQUAL "gb")
        target_link_libraries(lmx_bundles_check_${part} PRIVATE LMX::gb)
      elseif(part STREQUAL "ea_libc")
        target_link_libraries(lmx_bundles_check_${part} PRIVATE LMX::ea_libc)
      else()
        target_link_libraries(lmx_bundles_check_${part} PRIVATE LMX::cute_${part})
      endif()
      add_test(NAME bundles_extra.${part} COMMAND lmx_bundles_check_${part})
      set(_testdir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/test-output/${part}")
      file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_testdir}")
      set_tests_properties(bundles_extra.${part} PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY "${_testdir}" TIMEOUT 30)
      if(part STREQUAL "sound")
        set_tests_properties(bundles_extra.sound PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy")
      endif()
    endif()
  endforeach()
endif()

if(LMX_BUNDLES_EXTRA_BUILD_TESTS)
  add_executable(lmx_cute_net_upstream tests/net_upstream.c)
  lmx_bundle_target(lmx_cute_net_upstream)
  target_include_directories(lmx_cute_net_upstream PRIVATE "${_gen}" "${LMX_BUNDLES_VENDOR_DIR}/cute_headers")
  if(UNIX)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_cute_net_upstream PRIVATE m)
  elseif(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_cute_net_upstream PRIVATE ws2_32 bcrypt)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME bundles_extra.net_upstream COMMAND lmx_cute_net_upstream)
  set_tests_properties(bundles_extra.net_upstream PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)
endif()
